description: LETICIA FOR CONGRESS. Official campaign website for Leticia Gutierrez, Democratic candidate for U.S. House of Representatives in Texas, District 9 (TX-09), which stretches from the East End to the Bay Area and Harris County to Liberty County. Leticia is proudly progressive and centers environmental justice and immigrant rights in her campaign. Sign up on this site for updates, RSVP for events, and donate to the campaign.
